header: Where each stage of the grid programme stands
lead: Five stages, one budget and a deadline set by the concession agreement, not by us. Two stages are finished, two are under way and one has not started.
note: Percentages are the project office's own estimate at the end of December 2026, not independently checked. A stage at 0 % is planned and funded but not started.

metrics.title: Ashcombe substation rebuilt
metrics.text: Commissioned in March 2026, four months later than planned and within budget.

metrics.title: Deepwell 20 kV ring closed
metrics.text: Closed in September 2026. The district now has two independent feeds.

metrics.title: Marrowfield pumping station
metrics.text: Building work is finished. The pumps are due in May 2027.

metrics.title: Old Harbour cable renewal
metrics.text: 31 of 113 km laid. The harbour works slowed progress until August 2026.

metrics.title: Stonebeck storage site
metrics.text: Planning application submitted in November 2026. Construction starts in 2028.
